SELECT AA.* , E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , CASE WHEN AA.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD NOT IN ('30', '40') THEN '' ELSE AA.FILT_DTCT_NO END AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM( SELECT '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD , NVL(EP.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, IP.TDOC_RCP_CUCD) AS FC_CUNM , NVL(EP.XPBY_COL_AM, IP.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(EP.CUS_KORL_NM, IP.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(EP.CSNO, IP.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO , ( SELECT MAX(X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '100' AND H.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM DESC
ORDER BY ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM
ORDER BY INPT_PRCSNM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM DESC
ORDER BY FC_CUNM
ORDER BY FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY INPT_ATVTNM DESC
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY AA.FILT_DTCT_NO
ORDER BY AA.FILT_DTCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY WRR_INFO
ORDER BY WRR_INFO DESC
ORDER BY INPT_RCP_DT DESC

/* RevertTodoMapper.selectListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM( SELECT '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD , NVL(EP.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, IP.TDOC_RCP_CUCD) AS FC_CUNM , NVL(EP.XPBY_COL_AM,IP.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , NVL(EP.CUS_KORL_NM,IP.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , NVL(EP.CSNO, IP.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , ( SELECT MAX(FILT_DTCT_NO) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO FROM CSPD007TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS FILT_DTCT_NO , ( SELECT MAX(X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC )AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH H , CSPD112TI X WHERE H.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '100' AND H.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD(+) = '300' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD(+) = H.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD ) AS WRR_INFO
